selection_protocol.score_formula: signed_tdir_mean + 60 * anti_parallel_rate + 20 * abs(log(tmag_median_ratio + eps)) + 10 * abs(log(path_ratio + eps))

final360i_selection.selection_reason: FINAL360I retrain remained balanced and comparable to or better than original STRUCT360B, so the retrained checkpoint is recommended as the thesis main model.

convention_sanity.selection_reason: Manifest `R_BA` / `t_BA_B` matches `T_BA = inv(T_B) @ T_A` under GT-vs-GT sanity.

pair_mapping.matching_method: exact timestamp match after BASE360C pred_tum timestamp remap onto canonical GT timestamps

caveats: component metrics are derived from trajectory outputs and canonical manifest post-processing
official input used a 0.5x image adapter to avoid full-resolution OOM
trajectory_path_ratio and pair_component_path_ratio are distinct and both reported
adjacent-only metrics are supplemental; all-pair metrics are used for the unified comparison table
